page.overview:
Who is Covarla Baldene?

Covarla's has a One Power strength level of , just enough to be able to Travel. Covarla learned the weave from Katerine.

She has been Aes Sedai as long as Elaida a'Roihan had been alive. She is strong enough to Travel . She was born in and went to the Tower in . She spent nine years as a novice and five as Accepted. She was raised in 950 NE.

She returned to the White Tower from the debacle of Dumai's Wells in the early hours of the morning to give Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan the bad news that Rand al'Thor had escaped.

She stands highest among the twelve sisters that initially returned back to Tar Valon. Elaida has her and her group stay away from the White Tower to hide her secrets and stay in the village of Dorlan.
